name: 78612 · Cedar Creek, TX
findings: ZIP 78612 (Cedar Creek) has 24 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 78612 (Cedar Creek) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 78612 (Cedar Creek) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 59% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.
